requested_by: Tyler: 'Test all of the left out items' (NFL bets, other college tracks, college + NFL mixed, A+-only pools, NFL ordinary legs)
method: identical to round_robin_grid_prereg.json (N = 4..10 top picks by edge or all picks; every k-leg combination k = 2..6 and 2-6 together; same-game legs never combined; product of leg odds; pushes drop out; equal stake per parlay, 1 unit per week; compared with the same picks as singles; pass = beats singles on realized ROI and CLV-implied ROI in BOTH periods with drawdown <= 1.5x singles)
slates: Tuesday-Monday weeks of kickoff (so Monday Night Football joins its Sunday)

legs.nfl_aplus_ml: A+ moneyline track rule on history: first snapshot per game where the best allowed-book offer's frozen grade v2 predicted CLV >= 2.5% (scripts/research/grade_v2.py table/candidates/best_offers/first_with, frozen model grade_v2_frozen.json); edge = predicted CLV
legs.nfl_aplus_spread: A+ spread track rule: grade v1 A+ at its first appearance among research-filtered prices -145..+125 (scripts/research/grade_v2_spread.py v1_eval selection); edge = v1 blend EV
legs.nfl_aplus_totals: A+ totals track rule: first snapshot per game where the best totals offer's frozen totals-grade predicted CLV >= 0 (scripts/research/grade_granular.py tcandidates/best_per_snapshot/first_with, grade_totals_frozen.json); edge = predicted CLV
legs.college_shop: as before (shop vs sharp at your books)
legs.college_aplus: college shop legs with EV >= 4% only
legs.college_ml: College moneyline track v3 on history: P1 (EV >= 2% vs Pinnacle no-vig) or P2 (EV >= 2% vs Pinnacle's spread-implied price and >= 0 vs its moneyline) at your books, -300..+300, >= 1 h before kickoff, one bet per game at the first qualifying snapshot (scripts/research/cfb/price_screen.py logic)

dedupe: within a pool, one leg per game per market (the earliest); a game's moneyline and spread are the same market family, so if both appear only the earliest is kept
caveat_declared_in_advance: the NFL grade models were fit on 2020-2022, so NFL legs in the 2021-22 development period are in-sample for the grade; 2023-25 is clean
do_not_edit: do not change after seeing results
